description: Defines adapter classes for connecting various SDU notifiers and handlers within the F1AP, F1-U, RLC, and MAC layers of a telecommunications protocol stack, including connection management and notification handling.

classes.name: f1c_rx_sdu_rlc_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting F1AP Rx SDU notifier to RLC Tx SDU handler.

classes.name: f1u_rx_rlc_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting F1-U Rx SDU notifier to RLC Tx SDU handler.

classes.name: f1u_gateway_nru_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for F1-U Gateway to handle NR-U RX PDU messages.

classes.name: rlc_rx_rrc_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for RLC RX upper layer data notifier to F1c bearer.

classes.name: rlc_f1u_tx_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for RLC TX upper layer data notifier to F1U TX handler.

classes.name: rlc_f1c_tx_data_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC to F1-C bearer, handling transmit/delivery notifications.

classes.name: rlc_f1u_tx_data_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC to F1-U, handling transmit/delivery/retransmit notifications.

classes.name: rlc_tx_control_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC TX control events like protocol failure and max retransmission.

classes.name: rlc_tx_mac_buffer_state_updater
classes.description: Updates MAC with RLC buffer state information.

classes.name: mac_sdu_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting MAC SDU reception to RLC RX.

classes.name: mac_sdu_tx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting MAC SDU transmission to RLC TX.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection between notifier and handler.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the notifier from the handler.

methods.name: on_buffer_state_update
methods.description: Updates MAC with RLC buffer state.
